content: Agandi mabuye g’amarhegeko
Nyakasane anacibwîra Mûsa, erhi: «Obînje nnambi ibiri za mabuye nka zirya ntanzi, nayandika kuli ezo nnambi birya binwa byonêne byàli kuli zirya ntanzi wajonjagaga.
“Obè ocîrheganyize irhondo sêzi oyishisôkera sêzi-sêzi oku ntondo ya Sînayi, oyimange embere zâni oku busoso bw’entondo”.
“Ntâye wasôkanaga mweshi ciru n’omuguma na ntâye wabonekaga oku ntondo kwoshi, ciru n’ebibuzi n’enkafu, birhakereraga ebw’eyôla ntondo.”»
Mûsa abinja ennâmbi nka zirya ntanzi, anacizûka sêzi-sêzi, asôkera oku ntondo ya Sînayi nka kulya Nyakasane ànamurhegekaga erhi adwîrhe zirya nnambi ibirhi z’amabuye.
Nyakasane anacibunguluka omu citù ayimanga halya bo naye. Nyamubâho abonekera Mûsa Mûsa erhi adwîrhe ayâkûza izîno lya Nyakasane.
Nyakasane anacigera embere zâge, ajà ayâkûza, erhi: «Nyakasane, Nyamubâho, Nyamuzinda w’obwonjo, ntabâcihûngo, ntakunira-duba, oyunjula bwinjà n’obwîkubagirwa,

“oyôrha mwîkubagirwa w’iburha oku lindi, we lembera obubî, obuhalanjisi n’ecâha, ci orhaleka obubî bwagera kwônene, onashimbulule obubî bw’ababusi n’abâna oku binjikulu bâbo kuhika oku iburha lya kasharhu n’erya kani.”»
Ho n’aho Mûsa anacifukama, ahwêra oku idaho.

Aderha, erhi: «Akabà ko binali Yâgirwa ntonyire omu masù gâwe, Waliha oyêmêre okugenda nîrhu, bulya olu lubaga luli lwa ba cikanyi-cirhagômba, ci orhubêre obwonjo oku mabî gîrhu, onarhujire mwîmo gwâwe!»
Okushubilumûla Endagâno

Nyakasane aderha; erhi: «Nkola nafundika endagâno, najira ebirhangâzo embere ly’olubaga, birya birhasagiboneka ciru n’eliguma omu mashanja, n’olu lubaga lwoshi olimwo lwabona ebijiro bya Nyakasane, bulya biri bya kujugumya ebi nakola n’okuboko kwâwe!
“Obikirire bwinjà ebi nakurhegekaga ene! Embere zâwe nkola nakûngusha Abamoriti, Abakanani, Abahititi, Abapereziti, Abahiviti n’Abayebusi”.
“Omanye irhondo orhahîraga mpu wanywâna n’abantu babà omu cihugo wajamwo, balekibà murhego kuli we”.
“Ci amahêro
gâbo oyishigakûndula, emitûngo yâbo oyijonjage n’emirhi yâbo y’amahêro, ojè wayitwa”.
“Wêhe orhahîra okaharâmya owundi nyamuzinda, bulya izîno lya Nyakasane ye Lûji
, abà Nyamuzinda wa lûji”.
“Orhahîra okanywâna mwene abantu ba muli eco cihugo: bulya amango bakola bacîhemula na banyamuzinda wâbo, bankanakuhamagala obone wamalya oku nterekêro zâbo”;
“erhi bagala bâwe bankabashebera bâli bâbo, bâli bâbo banayishicihemulira emwa banyamuzinda bâbo, obone bamakululirayo na bagala bâwe, mpu nabo bacîhemulire emwa banyamuzinda bâbo”.
“Orhahîraga okatula banyamuzinda b’ecûma”.

“Okazilanga olusiku lw’emigati erhalimwo lwango. Okazijira nsiku nda zoshi walya emigati erhalimwo lwango, nka kulya nakurhegekaga, omu mango garhegesirwe n’omwêzi gw’Emihuli, bulya omwêzi gw’Emihuli, go mwêzi warhengagamwo e Mîsiri”.
“Ngasi coshi cizibûla omulà gwa nnina, ciri câni: ngasi lubere lw’omu masô gâwe, akabà lwa nkâfu, erhi lwa cibuzi”.

“Ci olubere lw’endogomi, okaziluhânira engombôlo y’omwâna-buzi, akabà orhaluhanîri engombôlo, onaluniole igosi. Ngasi lubere lwa muli bagala bâwe, okaziluhânira engombôlo. Ngasi murhabana wâwe w’olubere, okaz’imugombôla, murhanakâgiyisha maboko mûmu embere zâni”.
“Okazikola nsiku ndarhu, ci olusiku lwa kali nda wanarhamûka, ciru gankaba mango ga kubiba erhi kusârûla, onarhamûke”.
“Okazijira olusiku lukulu lw’Emigobe, lwo lw’emyâka mirhanzi-rhanzi y’engano, n’olusiku lukulu lw’okusârûla aha buzinda bw’omwâka”.
“Kasharhu omu mwâka, ngasi mulume ayishikazilola obusù bwa Nnâhamwâbo, Nyakasane, Nyamuzinda w’Israheli”.

“Bulya hano mbà namakungusha amashanja goshi embere zâwe, mbà namayûshûla ecihugo câwe, ntâye ciru n’omuguma waderhe mpu ayâgalwa n’ecihugo câwe amango warherema, ogendilola obusù bwa Nyakasane, Nyamuzinda wâwe, kasharhu omu mwâka”.
“Orhahîra okanterekêra emigati erimwo olwango, n’enterekêro y’olusiku lukulu lwa Basâka erhakâgigeza budufu kuhika sêzi”.
“Okazirhûla emyâka mirhanzi-rhanzi y’ishwa lyâwe omu ka-Nyamuzinda, Nyakasane wâwe. Orhahîraga okayendera omwânahene omu mahenehene ga nnina”»
Nyakasane abwîra Mûsa, erhi: «Oyandike ebyo binwa, bulya ebyo binwa byo nfundisire mwo endagâno haguma nâwe na haguma n’Israheli.»

Mûsa abêra okwo ntondo bo na Nyakasane, miregerege makumi anni na madufu makumi anni. Arhalyaga mugati, arhananywaga mîshi. Ayandika ebinwa by’endagâno kuli zirya nnambi ibirhi z’amabuye, birya binwa ikumi.
Mûsa ashubira oku icumbi
Erhi Mûsa àyandagala oku ntondo ya Sînayi, Mûsa ali adwîrhe zirya nnambi zombi z’Endagâno omu maboko, na Mûsa arhâli amanyire oku obusù bwâge bwakazâgilangashana kurhenga aho àshambazagya Nyakasane.
Aroni na Bene Israheli boshi babona Mûsa, obusù bwâge bwâlibudwîrhe bwalangashana, bayôboha okumuyegêra.
Mûsa abahamagala, lêro Aroni n’abagula b’olubaga boshi bamujayo, naye Mûsa abashambâza.
Cazînda Bene Israheli boshi bamujayo, naye Mûsa abaganîza, anakomêreza ngasi byoshi Nyakasane amubwîraga oku ntondo ya Sînayi.
Erhi Mûsa àyûsa okubashambâza, anacibwikira obusù n’omwenda.
N’erhi Mûsa àbâga ajà embere za Nyakasane mpu bashambâle bo naye, anakûle gulya mwenda, kuhika ahuluke. Erhi abâga amâhuluka, anabwîre Bene Israheli amarhegeko ahîrwe.
Bene Israheli bàkâgibona oku obusù bwa Mûsa budwîrhe bwalangashana. Lêro Mûsa ashubikaz’ibwîkira obusù bwâge n’omwenda, kuhika ashubigend’ishambâla bône Nyamuzinda.

footnotes.text: 34, 13 Amahêro: mizbeah, gali mabuye magwîke, gali ga kukengêza abantu ebi bànywânaga: Murh 31, 51-52; Lub 24, 4; Yoz 24, 26-27. Gàli ga kukengêza abantu nyakwîgendera: Murh 35, 20; 2 Sam 18, 18. Càli cimanyîso c’okuyêrekana aka-Nyamuzinda: Murh 28, 18.

34, 14 Okuderha oku Nyamuzinda abà wa lûji, kuli kuhamîriza bwinjinjà oku obuzigire bwâge burhajà lushangi, oku arhahimwa luhali. Nyamuzinda arhabà lûji lwa bantu, ci lûji lwa banyamuzi­nda, balya abantu bakazilonza okumushushanya: Lub 20, 5.
